name: Setup Wizard rescue covers every PID profile the board has
step: Check that the rescue step reads and writes every PID profile and keeps the active one
rationale:
The rescue step capped the profile count at three. Boards with more than 256K of flash have six PID profiles
(firmware target/common_pre.h), so profiles 4 to 6 were never written, and with one of them active the step showed
profile 1's value while the profile being flown kept its own.

The harness drives the real setup_wizard_rescue.lua against a simulated flight controller that keeps a rescue profile per
PID profile and answers profile selection, and pins: with six profiles and profile 5 active, all six are read, profile 5's
value is shown, a change reaches all six, and profile 5 is selected again; with three profiles, nothing above profile 3 is
selected, read or written.

--self-test caps the step at three profiles again and requires the six-profile checks to go red.
